Construction Packages & Material Tiers

Select your preferred level of fit-out finish. All options include full structural construction, architectural blueprints, and city permit submissions.

Cheapest Entry Tier

₱25,000 - ₱32,000 / sq.m

  • • Rough Concrete Slab Flooring

// TRANSPARENT WORKFLOW

5-Step Design-Build Roadmap

Clear stages, fixed milestones, and total transparency from day one.

01

Pre-Design

Client brief and requirements, ocular inspection, site analysis, local codes, and initial budget alignment.

02

Design Development

Schematic designs, 3D photorealistic renderings, mock-ups, and material selection.

03

Construction Documents

Blueprints, city permits, analysis, and contract documents.

04

Construction Phase

Active construction with direct architect daily supervision and weekly reports.

05

Turnkey Handover

Post construction, final inspections, as-built plans, occupancy permit issuance, key handover, retentions, and warranty.
